revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a utility-room passage. Rear-oblique view, medium-wide framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Scene includes cabinets, conduits, inspection access panels, large neutral floor and wall tiles, slightly dim but readable ambient light. Visible subject is an older adult man with a stocky build wearing a charcoal cardigan, light neutral clothing, and practical shoes, at the top of a push-up with hands and toes bearing the load and chest clearly held off the floor. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, doorway and structural lines create depth without blocking subject. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
